{{Quote|Step right up and get a kiss from one of our attractive Meatlumps. Guaranteed to make you feel all mushy or you get your Lump back!|A Meatlump drooler|<ref name="SWG:MTP">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other|"Meatlumps Theme Park" on Corellia}}</ref>}}
A '''drooler''' was a service position held within the [[Meatlumps]], a gang of technology-hating [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorists]] based out of their [[Meatlump Hideout|hideout]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], two droolers, a [[Gender/Legends|man]] and a woman, operated a kissing booth within the confines of the Meatlump sewer hideout. In exchange for one [[Meatlump Lump]], the droolers would kiss their customers. It was not uncommon for the Meatlump droolers, after kissing a customer, to transmit a [[Virus|viral]] infection called [[Meatlump Mono]]. People who got this infection could go to the Meatlump complaint department, staffed by [[Gitchur Lumpback]], to demand a refund of their Meatlump Lump. However, Lumpback would put customers through an endless bureaucratic process.<ref name="SWG:MTP" />

==Behind the scenes==
Meatlump droolers were [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player characters]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:MTP" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> They were added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Meatlumps Theme Park|Meatlumps Theme Park]]", introduced with "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 10|Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King]]," released on [[June 19]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67812&month=062008|text=Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King}}</ref>
